News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings – Nov. 15, 2026 10:40 AM November 15, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 10:40 AM November 15, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines takes center stage as it hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 18, bringing together Southeast Asian leaders and key dialogue partners in Manila. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will chair the opening ceremony and the leaders’ plenary and retreat sessions at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City.
Among the key issues on the agenda are the crisis in Myanmar, tensions in the South China Sea, regional security and economic cooperation. The meetings will also give Asean leaders an opportunity to assess the Philippines’ chairship priorities and discuss the bloc’s response to pressing regional and global challenges. Follow our live updates for the latest developments, key statements and announcements from the summit. /dl
